BEGIN;

LOCK TABLE teacher_onboarding_interaction IN ACCESS EXCLUSIVE MODE;
LOCK TABLE teacher_onboarding_turn IN SHARE MODE;
LOCK TABLE teacher_dialog_job IN SHARE MODE;
LOCK TABLE teacher_onboarding_action_receipt IN SHARE MODE;

-- The mixed-fleet drain is mandatory. NULL is retained only for terminal
-- historical evidence whose originating session schema cannot be proven.
DO $$
BEGIN
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM teacher_onboarding_interaction
        WHERE state IN ('active', 'reserved', 'handoff_pending')
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'cannot install migration 023: ambiguous nonterminal onboarding interactions must drain';
    END IF;
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM teacher_onboarding_turn
        WHERE stage IN ('received', 'interaction_reserved', 'ai_staged', 'student_staged', 'response_staged', 'delivery_pending')
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'cannot install migration 023: nonterminal onboarding turns must drain';
    END IF;
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM teacher_dialog_job
        WHERE coordinator_mode IN ('onboarding_action', 'onboarding_text')
          AND status IN ('queued', 'processing', 'delivery_pending')
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'cannot install migration 023: nonterminal onboarding coordinator jobs must drain';
    END IF;
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM teacher_onboarding_action_receipt
        WHERE status IN ('claimed', 'applied')
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'cannot install migration 023: nonterminal onboarding receipts must drain';
    END IF;
END $$;

ALTER TABLE teacher_onboarding_interaction
    ADD COLUMN session_schema_version SMALLINT,
    ADD CONSTRAINT teacher_onboarding_interaction_session_schema_version_ck
        CHECK (session_schema_version IS NULL OR session_schema_version IN (1, 2, 3)),
    ADD CONSTRAINT teacher_onboarding_interaction_session_admission_ck
        CHECK (session_schema_version IS NOT NULL OR state IN ('superseded', 'completed', 'closed'));

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION protect_teacher_onboarding_session_schema_version()
RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$
BEGIN
    IF TG_OP = 'INSERT' AND (NEW.session_schema_version IS NULL OR NEW.session_schema_version NOT IN (1, 2, 3)) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'new teacher onboarding interaction requires session schema version 1..3';
    END IF;
    IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' AND OLD.session_schema_version IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.session_schema_version THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'teacher onboarding session schema version is immutable';
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

CREATE TRIGGER trg_protect_teacher_onboarding_session_schema_version
BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON teacher_onboarding_interaction
FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION protect_teacher_onboarding_session_schema_version();

CREATE TABLE teacher_onboarding_terminal_session (
    terminal_session_id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    student_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (student_id ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'),
    personal_teacher_id UUID NOT NULL,
    dialog_id UUID NOT NULL,
    session_schema_version SMALLINT NOT NULL CHECK (session_schema_version = 3),
    state_ref_kind VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL CHECK (state_ref_kind IN ('accepted_draft', 'finalized_profile')),
    state_ref_version BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (state_ref_version > 0),
    terminal_kind VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL CHECK (terminal_kind = 'ACTIVE_PATH_EXISTS'),
    terminal_message_command_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('message_pending', 'delivered')),
    dialog_message_id UUID UNIQUE,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    delivered_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    FOREIGN KEY (personal_teacher_id, student_id) REFERENCES personal_teacher(id, student_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    CHECK ((status = 'message_pending' AND dialog_message_id IS NULL AND delivered_at IS NULL)
        OR (status = 'delivered' AND dialog_message_id IS NOT NULL AND delivered_at IS NOT NULL)),
    CHECK (updated_at >= created_at AND (delivered_at IS NULL OR (delivered_at >= created_at AND updated_at >= delivered_at)))
);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION protect_teacher_onboarding_terminal_session()
RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$
BEGIN
    IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' THEN
        IF ROW(OLD.terminal_session_id, OLD.student_id, OLD.personal_teacher_id, OLD.dialog_id,
               OLD.session_schema_version, OLD.state_ref_kind, OLD.state_ref_version,
               OLD.terminal_kind, OLD.terminal_message_command_id, OLD.created_at)
           IS DISTINCT FROM
           ROW(NEW.terminal_session_id, NEW.student_id, NEW.personal_teacher_id, NEW.dialog_id,
               NEW.session_schema_version, NEW.state_ref_kind, NEW.state_ref_version,
               NEW.terminal_kind, NEW.terminal_message_command_id, NEW.created_at) THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'teacher onboarding terminal session identity is immutable';
        END IF;
        IF OLD.status = 'delivered' AND ROW(OLD.status, OLD.dialog_message_id, OLD.delivered_at)
            IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(NEW.status, NEW.dialog_message_id, NEW.delivered_at) THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'teacher onboarding terminal delivery acknowledgement is immutable';
        END IF;
        IF OLD.status = 'message_pending' AND NEW.status = 'delivered'
           AND (NEW.dialog_message_id IS NULL OR NEW.delivered_at IS NULL) THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'teacher onboarding terminal delivery acknowledgement must be complete';
        END IF;
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

CREATE TRIGGER trg_protect_teacher_onboarding_terminal_session
BEFORE UPDATE ON teacher_onboarding_terminal_session
FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION protect_teacher_onboarding_terminal_session();

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION protect_teacher_onboarding_terminal_session_delete()
RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$ BEGIN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'teacher onboarding terminal session evidence cannot be deleted';
END; $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

CREATE TRIGGER trg_protect_teacher_onboarding_terminal_session_delete
BEFORE DELETE ON teacher_onboarding_terminal_session
FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION protect_teacher_onboarding_terminal_session_delete();

CREATE TRIGGER trg_protect_teacher_onboarding_terminal_session_truncate
BEFORE TRUNCATE ON teacher_onboarding_terminal_session
FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION protect_teacher_onboarding_terminal_session_delete();

COMMIT;
